notes.title: Fight off pesky humans and raise spider babies in Isle Goblin, a blend of Stardew Valley and Terraria
notes.notes:
Kilowatt Games are currently working on Isle Goblin, a curious blend of features from the likes of Stardew Valley and Terraria that I'm pretty excited to see more from.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/02/fight-off-pesky-humans-and-raise-spider-babies-in-isle-goblin-a-blend-of-stardew-valley-and-terraria/
